summary: Restart a Timeout's timing window from the current time without allocating a new JavaScript handle.

target.notes: Reschedule using the original duration and return the same handle; preserve ref state.

semantics.timing: start time becomes now with original delay
semantics.reactivation: a timeout that already fired can be reactivated

caveats: refresh() changes when the callback becomes eligible; it is not merely metadata.
Do not allocate a replacement object because handle identity is observable.

tests.name: can reactivate fired timeout
tests.input: let n=0; const t=setTimeout(()=>{n++; if(n===1)t.refresh(); else {console.log(n);clearTimeout(t)}},1);
